(b) External Pressure Stresses. Stresses due to external pressure shall be considered safe when the wall thickness of the piping component, and its means of stiffening, meet the requirements of para. 304.

(c) Stresses Due to Sustained Loads, SL. The stresses due to sustained loads, SL, in any component in a piping system (see para. 320), shall not exceed Sh, where Sh is the basic allowable stress provided in Table A-1 (Table A-1C) at the metal temperature for the operating condition being considered.
